entities.name: Reconfiguration with sync
entities.description: Procedure executed by UE to perform reconfiguration with synchronization, involving timer management, security checks, and configuration changes.

entities.name: AS security not activated
entities.description: Condition where AS security is not activated, leading to transition to RRC_IDLE state.

entities.name: No DAPS bearer configured
entities.description: Condition where no DAPS bearer is configured, affecting timer operations.

entities.name: Procedure executed for MCG
entities.description: Condition indicating the procedure is executed for Master Cell Group.

entities.name: Timer T310
entities.description: Timer for SpCell, stopped when no DAPS bearer is configured.

entities.name: Timer T316
entities.description: Timer for MCG, stopped when procedure is executed for MCG.

entities.name: Timer T312
entities.description: Timer for SpCell, stopped during reconfiguration with sync.

entities.name: Timer T304
entities.description: Timer for SpCell, started when sl-PathSwitchConfig is not included.

entities.name: Timer T420
entities.description: Timer for target L2 U2N Relay UE, started when sl-PathSwitchConfig is included.

entities.name: newUE-Identity
entities.description: Information element used as C-RNTI in target cell group.

entities.name: sl-PathSwitchConfig
entities.description: Information element indicating target L2 U2N Relay UE identity and timer T420 value.

entities.name: reconfigurationWithSync
entities.description: Information element containing configuration parameters for reconfiguration with sync.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state entered when AS security is not activated.

entities.name: Suspend SRBs for source cell group
entities.description: Property where SRBs for source cell group are suspended during reconfiguration.

relations.description: Procedure execution is guarded by AS security activation condition.
Condition establishes transition to RRC_IDLE state.
Procedure stops timer T310 when no DAPS bearer is configured.
Procedure stops timer T316 when executed for MCG.
Procedure stops timer T312 for corresponding SpCell.
Procedure starts timer T420 for target L2 U2N Relay UE.
Procedure starts timer T304 when sl-PathSwitchConfig is not included.
Procedure uses sl-PathSwitchConfig for target L2 U2N Relay UE configuration.
Procedure uses reconfigurationWithSync for configuration parameters.
Procedure establishes suspension of SRBs for source cell group.
